title: Planet Pluto and its Remedies
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 21 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Pluto as Yamraj, letting go, Pluto by sign and house, thread and charity remedies, conjunctions and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 21, Planet Pluto and its Remedies by Brajesh Gautam: letting go, Pluto by sign and house, folk remedies, conjunctions and video timestamps.
points: Pluto is Yamraj, the god of Dharma and death.
He takes old forms so new ones can come: a house, a job, a body. The fix is a guru and not panicking.
Crying over one thing for years gives Pluto your whole hold. Drop a habit all at once and it settles.
Pluto is cold and traps water.
It traps the Moon, the mind. Wherever the mind is stuck, that area of life goes cold.
Cow, dog, fish, buffalo, pigeon and crow. Ketu covers death like a cloud.
Remedies are by sign and house.
Threads, charity by house number, gulkand in open ground, and a few folk tricks.
Buying a child, false death news and looking at someone without consent are noted only as said, and are not endorsed.
Health, money, politics and sexuality remarks are his opinion. See a doctor and use lawful channels.
